Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Neurologist to provide expert neurological care across diverse clinical settings. The ideal candidate will possess comprehensive knowledge of neurological disorders, advanced diagnostic skills, and a commitment to delivering exceptional patient-centered services. You will have the flexibility to manage your schedule while contributing to high-quality neurological practice, utilizing cutting-edge technology and evidence-based approaches to improve patient outcomes.

Responsibilities

Conduct thorough neurological evaluations, including patient history, physical examinations, and diagnostic assessments.
Interpret medical imaging such as MRI, CT scans, and neurodiagnostic tests to diagnose neurological conditions accurately.
Develop individualized treatment plans encompassing pharmacologic management, procedural interventions, and rehabilitative strategies.
Perform specialized procedures including lumbar punctures, nerve blocks, and botulinum toxin treatments for applicable conditions.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in inpatient and outpatient settings to coordinate comprehensive care.
Utilize electronic health record (EHR) systems such as Epic or EMR systems to document patient encounters meticulously.
Stay current with advancements in neurology through clinical research, continuing education, and participation in professional development activities.
Personal injury experience not required but preferred

Requirements

Must be licensed in Texas
Medical degree (MD or DO) with board certification or eligibility in Neurology from an accredited institution.
Valid medical license for practice within the designated jurisdiction.
Proven experience in inpatient neurology, neurocritical care, or outpatient neurology clinics.
Familiarity with medical imaging modalities including CT and MRI interpretation.
Knowledge of EMR systems such as Epic or other healthcare IT platforms.
Strong understanding of physiology, neuroanatomy, and clinical evaluation techniques.
Experience with procedures like lumbar punctures, neurodiagnostic testing, and interventional radiology techniques related to neurology.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex conditions clearly to patients and team members.
Ability to work independently while adhering to HIPAA regulations and maintaining patient confidentiality. Join our team as a Neurologist and contribute your expertise to advancing neurological health through innovative care delivery and compassionate patient service!

License/Certification:

Texas License (Required)
